overall_summary: Analysis of 50 YouTube Shorts shows strong audience affinity for short-duration time-bounded catastrophic anomalies ('for 5 Seconds') and celestial scale transformations. Top-performing videos consistently achieve over 60-70% average percentage watched and pull up to 1,038 views. Looping hooks create extreme rewatchability (up to 361.81% average view percentage). High drop-offs occur on abstract concepts lacking immediate visual payoff.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' yielded 881 views with 64.26% avg view percentage; 'What If the Sun Blinked Off for 5 Seconds?' achieved 71.59% avg view percentage.
what_is_working.action: Frame future video premises around immediate, high-stakes time constraints (e.g., 5 seconds or 10 seconds) to create urgent curiosity.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' achieved 361.81% average view percentage, starting with a 4.5x audience watch ratio and retaining over 3.5x at 49% progress.
what_is_working.action: Design seamless audio-visual end-to-beginning loops that incentivize multiple consecutive rewatches.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' pulled 1,038 views, and 'What If Earth Swapped Orbits With Ice Giants' generated 73.89% average view percentage.
what_is_working.action: Prioritize large-scale planetary sky-transformation visual hooks in the first 0-3 seconds.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Reversed For 5 Seconds?' lost 90% relative retention by 23% progress; 'What If Earth's Atmosphere Turned to Liquid?' dropped to 6.7% relative retention at mid-point.
what_to_improve.action: Replace abstract physics concepts with immediate visual consequences like tangible destruction or dramatic sky alterations.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Cosmic Dust?' suffered an audience watch ratio decline from 1.21 to 0.30 by 49% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Introduce secondary visual shifts or escalating consequences every 3-5 seconds to sustain retention.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Core Froze Solid for 5 Seconds?' held an audience watch ratio above 3.5x across the entire first half of the video.
retention_insights.action: Structure short scripts with open-ended payoff teasers at the end that transition seamlessly into the opening statement.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Reversed For 5 Seconds?' saw relative retention plunge from 0.3044 at 1% progress to 0.0992 at 23% progress.
retention_insights.action: Ensure the visual hook immediately shows impact within 0.5 seconds rather than relying on verbal setup.

best_posting_windows.reason: Yielded top reach including 1,038 views for Saturn Rings video at 04:56 UTC and 701 views for Sound in Space at 04:47 UTC.
Produced peak high-retention performance including 881 views (64.26% avg percentage watched) at 12:08 UTC and 397 views at 12:49 UTC.
